rule: Validation reports all structural errors before considering semantic errors, deterministically and without calling a backend.

assertions: No semantic hidden/missing-field decision is made until every structural error has been returned or repaired.
The same document yields the same structural error sequence on every adapter.
expected.gap: RFC §10 does not publish the promised error catalog, JSON Schema, structural limit constants, structural error ordering within a batch, or whether all structural errors are one result or sequential repair results.
